rules: Identity, cover composition and reusable rights must all pass before a row is promoted.
A Commons or VRT record does not authorize a modern architectural work when the public evidence does not establish the relevant architectural rights.
A photograph categorized under a work is rejected when that work is not actually legible as the image subject.
No production write is authorized until isolated PostgreSQL dry-run and fresh conflict precheck pass.

decisions.visual_finding: The Commons image shows the signed Emerson school facade. The Unsplash image is an unrelated concrete interior.

identity_evidence.claim: The Neutra Institute identifies Emerson Junior High School as Richard Neutra's Los Angeles school project.

decisions.visual_finding: The Commons panorama clearly shows Musikhuset Esbjerg. The Unsplash image is an unrelated aerial roof view.

identity_evidence.claim: Musikhuset Esbjerg's official history identifies Jan and Jørn Utzon as its architects.

decisions.reason: The image is visually correct and has a VRT-confirmed photographer license, but the public ticket does not establish whether reuse also covers the still-protected French architectural work.
The Commons file description identifies Palazzo della Pilotta; the modern fountain is not a legible image subject, and Italian modern-work rights remain unresolved.
The building identity is correct, but the prominently included Ota Dokan sculpture lacks a separately verified globally reusable rights chain.

verification.commons_method: Wikimedia Commons imageinfo, extmetadata, current file wikitext and visual inspection
